d: Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ko dularchand yadav hatyakand men suprim kort se bara jhatka laga hai. suprim kort ne unki jamanat radd karte hue 1 disanbar 2026 tak sarendar karne ka aadesh diya hai. jastis em.em. sundesh aur jastis pi.vi. varale ki pith ne patna haeekort ke jamanat aadesh ko palat diya. beti ki shadi ka havala dekar sarendar ke lie atirikt samay mangne ki anant sinh ki apil bhi svikar nahin ki gaee. kort ne mamle ki ganbhirta ka jikr karte hue pulis ko char mahine ke bhitar janch puri karne ka nirdesh diya hai. janie suprim kort ke is phaisle se juri puri jankari.
